text: Ukraine struck a Russian oil refinery on Oct 30, ending a pause on such attacks and going against Trump's stated wishes. Separately, the Oleshky aid operation and evacuations are under way under the local ceasefire.

judge.comment: Core claim matches the Oct 30 event headline. 'Defying Trump' is taken from the digest wording; a human should confirm the framing and the ceasefire link for Oleshky.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine struck a Russian oil refinery, ending a pause on such attacks

factChecks.source: ukraine-war digest wording; no further detail in tracker data

factChecks.claim: Oleshky aid operation and evacuations under way

text: How much Russian refining is down? Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026. The IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak. Reuters found national oil processing fell only 3-6%, as undamaged refineries offset losses.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed with as-of dates where the tracker gives them; no adjudication. Reuters and IEA dates are not given in the tracker, so a human should confirm.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% disabled in July 2026
factChecks.source: russian-fuel-crisis dispute 'How much Russian refining capacity has actually been disabled?'

factChecks.claim: Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3-6%, undamaged refineries offset losses
